packs.title: 30 ChatGPT Prompts to Study Smarter
packs.description: A student-friendly prompt pack for turning ChatGPT into a personal tutor, study planner, and exam-prep partner across any subject.
prompts: Explain [topic] to me like I'm a complete beginner, using a simple analogy.
Create a 7-day study schedule for my [subject] exam in [timeframe], with daily topics.
Quiz me with 10 multiple-choice questions on [topic] and check my answers.
Summarize [chapter/topic] into 5 key bullet points I can review quickly.
Turn these notes into flashcards (question/answer format): [paste notes].
Explain the difference between [concept A] and [concept B] with an example.
Create a mnemonic device to help me remember [list of items].
Act as a strict examiner and ask me tough short-answer questions on [subject].
Break down this complex sentence/paragraph into simpler terms: [paste text].
Give me 3 real-world examples of how [concept] is used in everyday life.
Create a mind map outline (in text form) connecting the main ideas of [topic].
Explain [topic] using a step-by-step process, numbered clearly.
Write a practice essay outline on [topic] with an intro, 3 body points, and conclusion.
Compare and contrast [theory A] and [theory B] in a table format.
Give me a list of common mistakes students make when learning [topic].
Explain [formula/equation] and walk through solving one example step by step.
Create 5 essay question prompts a professor might ask about [topic].
Summarize this article/text in 100 words: [paste text].
Act as my study accountability partner — ask me what I studied today and give feedback.
Explain [historical event] and its causes, effects, and significance.
Create a vocabulary list of 15 key terms for [subject] with simple definitions.
Help me create a Pomodoro-based study plan for a [X]-hour study session.
Explain [scientific concept] using a kitchen or household analogy.
Draft a set of self-reflection questions to check if I truly understand [topic].
Write a short story or scenario that illustrates [concept] in action.
Give me tips to memorize [type of content, e.g. dates, formulas, vocabulary].
Create a rubric I can use to self-grade my practice essay on [topic].
Explain why [common misconception] about [topic] is incorrect.
Generate 5 discussion questions for a study group session on [topic].
Act as a language tutor and correct my grammar in this paragraph: [paste text].
